title: CIVIL RIGHTS, IMMIGRATION, SOCIAL SERVICES, AND NEIGHBORHOODS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to naming the Reynier Village community in Council District 10.
text:
[Council File 26-1281; CD 10]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
CIVIL RIGHTS, IMMIGRATION, SOCIAL SERVICES, AND NEIGHBORHOODS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to naming the Reynier Village community in Council District 10.
Recommendation for Council action, as initiated by Motion (Hutt - Yaroslavsky):
DIRECT the Department of Transportation to fabricate and install three Official City community signs recognizing Reynier Village, after confirmation from the City Clerk that the following locations are within the established community boundaries:
South Robertson/ Cadillac
South Robertson/ Cattaraugus
Holt/Cadillac
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the CAO nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Directs the Department of Transportation to install three official city signs recognizing the Reynier Village community at three intersections, once the City Clerk confirms they are within the community boundaries.

locations.text: South Robertson Blvd & Cadillac Ave, Los Angeles, CA
South Robertson Blvd & Cattaraugus Ave, Los Angeles, CA
Holt Ave & Cadillac Ave, Los Angeles, CA

details.action: naming of community and installation of community signs

outcome.text: Council adopted item as amended by Amending Motion 9A (Hutt - McOsker), subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 21, 2026)
